title: symplocos gambliana
intro: Symplocos gambliana, commonly known as Indian alder, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It is believed to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Symplocos gambliana are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit cardiotonic activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
